translation:
Nagato and I met up with Haruhi in the hallway
with all the first-year classrooms.
Oh, where are Mikuru and Koizumi?

I lied, explaining that they'd gone to the
computer society to ask more questions.

Now then, this long hallway on the main
building's third floor ends at class 1-9.
I'm truly grateful. Please let it stay this way.
Hey, Haruhi, there's no class 1-10 here.

Obviously, Kyon. It wouldn't be one of the
seven wonders if it appeared so easily.

It appeared that easily in front of me, but I
could never tell Haruhi that.

I reckon there's some kind of trigger. I'm
gonna investigate every nook and cranny!

If you see anything unusual, report back to
your brigade chief immediately.
Here I go!

Haruhi is alone in her enthusiasm, pacing up
and down the long hallway.

Class 7, 8, 9… Hmm… There aren't any signs of
unnatural phenomena, huh.

I'm afraid not. Just an ordinary hallway. They
were just seeing things after all, right?
No, there's something here.

I'm certain! The "man-eating classroom” that
long has plagued North High, class 1-10!

First I've heard of that. Long or not—I only
heard about it today.

But maybe it won't appear in front of normal
humans. Like, you might need psychic powers.
If it's espers you need I happen to know one.

The computer society member who claimed to
have seen it probably just made a mistake.
Listen here, Kyon.

Aren't you being awfully unimaginative despite
being a member of the SOS Brigade?

I believe in it—that even ghosts and
unnatural phenomena exist!

The SOS Brigade was created to search for
them.
Whatever. It's just…

To tell you the truth, I've seen things like
ghosts and unnatural phenomena.

Incidentally, I don't have any psychic powers.
No guardian spirit either of course.

They say when cats or babies are looking
into empty space, they're looking at a ghost.

Oh yeah, Yuki, you also stare at thin air
sometimes, don't you? Just like a cat.
I do not see ghosts.

In Nagato's case, she probably sees
electromagnetic radiation or something.

I feel like out of all of us, Yuki might have the
best affinity for sensing the supernatural.
Don't you think, Kyon?

Nagato is… You're right, she does seem quite
cat-like.

Right?! That's why I think her sixth sense is
strong.
That's not related to psychic powers though.
No, it is related. Without a doubt.

In that case, you're quite dog-like so I guess
you can't sense the supernatural at all?
You're the one who's like a dog.

If anything you're a polar bear… or a sea lion
maybe.

As usual she says something awful. Just how
do you perceive me?
If I were a dog, I'd be a really impressive one.

The kind that would win the championship in a
dog contest even.

You'd never win. You wouldn't listen to your
owner at all.

That's right. I don't need an owner—I'm more
like a lone wolf.
…Wolves live in packs. They're not alone.
Nice comeback, Nagato.
I see. Then, being the alpha wolf is fine.

Nagato doesn't seem like a psychic. Isn't she
more like an ultra realist?
But she totally seems like a cat?

I think there's almost certainly a mistake with
a diagram that says cat = spiritual radar.
Although I do admit she's like one.

What are the characteristics that make me
look like a cat?

Listen, Yuki, there are different types.
There's cat-like people and dog-like people.
It's a loose analysis of someone's personality.
Yuki, let out a little "meow” sound!
Oi, don't mess with Nagato.
Meow.
No no no, do it with more emotion.
Meow.
Hmm, it's not quite right.
Haruhi, knock it off.

Setting that aside, let's use your abilities to
search for the supernatural, Yuki!
"Setting that aside” doesn't work here at all.
Okay, Yuki, go!
Haruhi started dragging Nagato away.

Do you sense anything suspicious over
there?
Nothing.

Then, is there something out of the ordinary
over here?
A presence cannot be confirmed.
There's gotta be something here!
Nothing is detected.

It's like she's searching for stolen goods with
a police dog, but can't find anything.

She's not going to tell Haruhi if there is som-
ething, but still—please don't find anything.

Hey, this hallway, doesn't it look different
from normal?
There are no people.
But it's more gloomy than usual.

Because it's summer vacation, the lights are
off.

Ah! Something just flew past the window just
now! A mysterious flying object!
A ball.

Yeah, the baseball club have come to
practice.

What was that weird sound? It sounded like a
poltergeist!

The baseball club is just making noise during
practice.

It is the sound of a ball coming into contact
with a bat, and then into contact with a mitt.
…There's nothing here. Boring.

That's why I said the unnatural phenomenon
was just a hoax.

It's just that the conditions haven't been
satisfied yet. We need to acquire more info.

I'm gonna go back for a while and re-examine
what we know.
Kyon and Yuki, search for leads!
Haruhi said over her shoulder while leaving.

Looks like she got bored. Thank goodness
nothing happened.

Hey, Nagato, has anything changed since
the data links became unstable?
Nagato?
Nagato's gaze was fixed on a single point.

As Haruhi said, she certainly seems very
cat-like, but…

It's already ominous when a cat does it, but if
it's you it makes me even more anxious.
Nagato, is there something there?

I couldn't see anything strange at the point
she was staring at.

Maybe she's receiving scattered radio waves
to verify the school's condition or something.

Don't tell me Nagato really was a psychic all
along.

Well, not that her abilities are practically that
different, I just mean emotionally.
It is spreading.
What is?

The data links are becoming more unstable
due to alternate space developing.
So you were checking the data links after all.

But it's spreading, huh. It would be best to
get Haruhi to leave the school, but…

Also, abnormal phenomena are becoming more
active due to Haruhi Suzumiya's desire.
Huh? That would mean—
Over there…
Nagato pointed outside the window.

Actually, since I asked, she's probably just
checking the whole school, right?

Just watching her, it looks like she's receiving
some kind of invisible radio waves.
I'm starting to get worried.

With Nagato, this isn't any joke or laughing
matter—it's reality.

The data links are becoming more unstable
due to alternate space developing.
I see.

It didn't seem like there was anything where
she was staring. I'm glad I didn't ask.

Also, abnormal phenomena activity is rising
due to Haruhi Suzumiya's desire. For example…
Nagato suddenly pointed outside the window.
Over there.
There's nothing there?

Nagato responded to my doubt by looking up
at me in silence.

But she turned back and walked away without
offering any explanation.
…What did she mean?

"You can't see it?” Was that the kind of
nuance you were going for?

I looked out the window once more to find
nothing.

I can't see anything equals there's nothing
there!

I tried to convince myself of that as I chased
after Nagato.

Did Nagato see something when Haruhi was
dragging her around to look at places…?
I became worried all over again.
She does seem like a cat.
I don't think so.
Ask Nagato
Don't ask Nagato
